🇲🇽🛢️ PEMEX HITS 388,000 BARRELS/DAY — GASOLINE OUTPUT UP 12.7%

Pemex produced 388,100 barrels of gasoline per day in April, a 12.7% annual increase. The Tula refinery led the national system at 99,600 bpd — up 30% year-over-year. Dos Bocas contributed 71,600 bpd.

Diesel production surged even harder: up 32.3% to 260,000 barrels per day.

While US gas prices hit $4.54/gallon amid the Iran war, Mexico's refining expansion keeps domestic fuel stable. Energy sovereignty isn't a slogan — it's 388,000 barrels a day.

From Milei to Bukele, the far-right is coordinating across the hemisphere. This was a job interview at the White House.

🇲🇽🏭 30,000 FREE SPOTS — MEXICO'S PUBLIC AI CENTER TRIPLES CAPACITY

Mexico's public AI training center just opened 30,000 spots for its second generation — triple the 10,000 in January's first cohort. Five months, fully online, completely free.

The curriculum spans AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing, data analysis, and 5G infrastructure, with job placement pipelines into NVIDIA, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, AWS, and Intel.

While the US guts public science funding, Mexico is building a free pipeline from zero tech background to employment at the world's biggest tech firms. Registration open through July 5.
